notes: For fixed alpha, suppressing polynomial factors gives this expression from Corollary 3.3. The first arXiv abstract already states N≈Õ(n exp(alpha²n/(1−2alpha)²)) advice vectors and Õ(nN) query time. At alpha=1/4 this specializes to exp(n/4+o(n)) time and advice, or base-2 coefficient log₂(e)/4≈0.3606737602. This example is part of the same tradeoff rather than a separate result or category. All costs here are per query or stored advice after unbounded target-independent preprocessing.

extra.preprocessing: Unbounded; source counts advice rather than its construction time
extra.parameters: Any fixed 0 < alpha < 1/2; exact corollary allows Omega(1/sqrt(n)) < alpha < 1/2
extra.success: Advice can be chosen to decode every promised target
extra.quarterRadiusExample: alpha=1/4: query time and advice exp(n/4+o(n)) = 2^{(log₂(e)/4)n+o(n)}, coefficient ≈0.36067376022224085
extra.model: Classical; query time after unbounded target-independent preprocessing
